purpose: CSV-side reference for the CIC2017 PCAP comparison (EXP94). Few-shot learning curves of XGBoost and frozen TabPFN on the official CICFlowMeter CSV with a chronological split and the complete held-out test, plus identical-input audits and an oracle ceiling. Companion of EXP93; no PCAP is used here.

features.policy: all 78 statistical columns; the duplicated 'Fwd Header Length' column is used once; Label is the only non-feature column
features.nonfinite_policy: rows with NaN or +/-Infinity in any feature are dropped before splitting and their counts are recorded per label

label_map_note: '*' stands for the non-UTF-8 dash byte in the Web Attack labels; matching is by prefix/suffix.

split.note: Rows of each CSV are kept in file order (CICFlowMeter emits flows in start-time order). Within each file and raw CIC label, the first 70% of that label's rows become train, the next 15% validation and the last 15% test. The first run (20261103_162600) split within file and family; because FTP-Patator precedes SSH-Patator on Tuesday, its bf test split contained only SSH flows. Test is retained completely.

fewshot.coverage_rule: A family is trained and scored only if its train split has at least max(budgets) rows and its test split at least one row; other families are excluded from both training and macro-F1 and listed in label_coverage.json.
fewshot.paired_sampling: Per family, seed and n, a deterministic max-n sample is drawn from the train split and its first n rows are used by both methods. Test rows are fixed across methods.

audits.identical_input: SHA256 over the float32 feature vector; cross-label groups are counted on the full labelled table and on the test split separately
audits.train_test_duplicates: fraction of test rows whose exact feature vector also occurs in the train split
audits.oracle_ceiling: On the test split, predict the majority family of each identical-feature group; its macro-F1 is the deterministic-classifier ceiling
